description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 scores for several machine learning models across different datasets. The horizontal axis represents the dataset, with categories labeled SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, presented in that order. The vertical axis represents the F1 score in percent, with a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals. There are four sets of bars for each dataset, representing the models MADLLM, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, pool, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The MADLLM bars are green, the MADLLM w/o feature embedding bars are purple, the pool bars are gray, and the MADLLM w/o skip embedding bars are red. For the SMD dataset, the bar heights are approximately 96, 89, 92, and 86 percent, respectively. For the WADI dataset, the bar heights are approximately 73, 71, 72, and 68 percent, respectively. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each group containing one bar for each of the four models. No bars are visually emphasized, and the datasets are presented in a fixed order without apparent sorting based on model performance.
